notes: Budgeted delivery E2, the live checks and guard 9 on the LongMemEval-S slice: real embeddings and the reranker, one process on its own VM, three rounds of one live query per packing with search.auto_packing switched through the config table.

cells.lease_basis: embeddings for the 100 slice haystacks about $1.53, 1,300 reranked queries about $1.10, x1.5 and headroom
cells.command: bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 1 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lme-s" -- --benchmark lme-s --limit 100 --seed 42 --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=live --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_lme_s}} --policy-setting live_reps=3 --frozen-from .e2-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson
cells.setup_command: BUN_VERSION=1.4.2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
